page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c1.large is a compute-optimized virtual server instance powered by the x86_64 CPU architecture and virtualized via the KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with 8 dedicated vCPUs and 16.0 GB of total RAM, providing 2.0 GB of memory per core.

The server includes no integrated GPUs and has no bundled local storage, meaning disk space must be provisioned through remote block storage options. With its dedicated vCPU allocation and 1:2 RAM-to-vCPU ratio, the resource distribution favors processing capacity over memory volume, eliminating CPU contention risks associated with shared-core burstable instances.

This hardware profile is tailored for compute-focused tasks that do not demand large in-memory caching or high-capacity local disk IOPS. Primary recommended workloads for this instance include web serving, CI/CD build servers, batch data processing, and lightweight ETL operations.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c1.large is a compute-optimized virtual server instance configured with 8 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs and 16.0 GB of memory, resulting in a 2.0 GB per core memory allocation. Operating on a KVM hypervisor, this instance provides dedicated processing capability without shared CPU burst constraints. It does not include bundled local disk storage or integrated GPUs, requiring users to attach external storage solutions for persistent data needs. The lower memory-to-vCPU ratio establishes a compute-dense configuration suitable for workloads that prioritize central processing capacity over large memory footprints. This hardware profile makes the ecs.c1.large an efficient option for compute-heavy applications such as continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines, batch job processing, web application backend serving, and lightweight ETL workflows.
